title: ASP.NET Core services
description: Configuration, request cancellation and integration checks for ASP.NET Core applications.

rules.instruction: Bind application options through the configured providers and validate required options at startup, before the app serves requests.
rules.verification: Start the test host using its normal configuration pipeline and confirm that valid and missing required settings produce the expected startup result.

rules.instruction: Read credentials from the environment's approved secret store, never from configuration files committed to the repository.
rules.verification: Search the committed configuration files for credential values and check that the app reads each credential through the configured secret provider.

rules.instruction: Pass the request cancellation token to downstream reads and other interruptible operations. Define which writes can be interrupted safely.
rules.verification: Cancel a test request and verify both the downstream cancellation and the final stored state where a write is involved.

rules.instruction: Exercise endpoints through the ASP.NET Core test host when a change touches middleware, routing, authorization or serialization.
rules.verification: Check the request's expected status, response and side effects for the relevant roles and inputs.
